role_agent_name: Thermal process and surface plant lead (PLT)
abstract: Maintains heat exchanger thermal transfer ratings and surface plant capital expenditure budgets
system_message:
You are the Thermal process and surface plant lead (PLT). Your responsibilities include maintaining heat exchanger thermal transfer ratings and surface plant capital expenditure budgets, alongside metallurgical pipe corrosion testing records for candidate geothermal heating consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Metallurgical pipe corrosion testing（PIPEQUAL）
information_points.content:
PLT-PIPEQUAL-I43：For Reykjanes District Energy Venture, ultrasonic testing of the corrosion-resistant alloy piping across the surface brine collection manifold spools measures a titanium alloy casing thickness of 16.0 mm.
PLT-PIPEQUAL-R8O：For Borealis Thermal Consortium, ultrasonic inspection of surface brine collection manifold pipe spools indicates a minimum titanium alloy casing thickness of 18.5 mm.
PLT-PIPEQUAL-FRJ：For Nordic GeoPower Alliance, ultrasonic wall thickness testing on the surface brine collection manifold pipe spools confirms a titanium alloy casing thickness of 14.5 mm.

information_points.title: Maintains heat exchanger thermal transfer ratings and surface plant capital expenditure budgets（THERMENG）
information_points.content:
PLT-THERMENG-JUG：For Reykjanes District Energy Venture, the central thermal distribution station plate heat exchangers attain a design heat exchanger thermal transfer efficiency of 91.5% at rated flow under winter design inlet temperatures, accompanied by a surface heat exchange plant capital commitment of 31000000 EUR.
PLT-THERMENG-9YD：For Nordic GeoPower Alliance, the plate heat exchangers at the central thermal distribution station exhibit a heat exchanger thermal transfer efficiency of 82.0% under winter design inlet conditions, and the consortium's surface heat exchange plant capital commitment stands at 37500000 EUR.
PLT-THERMENG-I8Y：For Borealis Thermal Consortium, the central thermal distribution station plate heat exchangers achieve a design heat exchanger thermal transfer efficiency of 86.5% at rated flow under winter design inlet temperatures, and the guaranteed surface heat exchange plant capital commitment for surface plant facilities is 31000000 EUR.
